description: Trading bot that decides buy/sell on a live price feed and executes real on-chain trades on Monad via Kuru's order book, one decision every ~300ms block.
how_used_jev: Jev answers a typed buy/sell question against the live price feed each block; the bot posts a real post-only limit order one tick inside the touch based on the answer.
author: @jarrodwatts

benchmark.notes: author reports ~81ms model latency; hot loop makes exactly two RPC round trips to fit the block budget

security_status.notes: executes real trades with real funds - high blast radius if Jev misjudges; good Watchdog-lens candidate once it's run longer
